name: Indefinite Leave to Remain (Skilled Worker route)

requirements.blocker_text: This requires 5 continuous years living in the UK on a qualifying visa, which you haven't yet reached.
requirements.fix_path: Continue residing in the UK on a qualifying visa until you reach the 5-year mark.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires not having been outside the UK for more than 180 days in any rolling 12-month period during the qualifying 5 years.
requirements.fix_path: Keep future absences under the 180-day rolling limit for the remainder of the qualifying period.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires your sponsor to still hold a valid sponsor licence and still need you in a role meeting the salary requirements at the time you apply.
requirements.fix_path: Confirm continued sponsorship and role eligibility with your employer before applying.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires your salary at the time of application to meet or exceed the going rate for your current occupation code.
requirements.fix_path: Ensure salary meets the current going rate for your SOC code before applying.

value.note: Life in the UK Test required for applicants aged 18-64

requirements.blocker_text: This requires passing the Life in the UK Test (unless you're outside the 18-64 age range that requires it).
requirements.fix_path: Book and pass the Life in the UK Test.

evidence_required.document: Life in the UK Test pass certificate
Employer/sponsor letter confirming continued need for the role and salary compliance
Record of all absences from the UK during the qualifying period

sources.title: Indefinite leave to remain if you have a Skilled Worker, Health and Care Worker, T2 or Tier 2 visa: Overview - GOV.UK
Indefinite leave to remain if you have a Skilled Worker visa: Eligibility - GOV.UK

notes: English language requirement is NOT retested at ILR stage for Skilled Worker holders — it was already proven at initial visa stage, so no requirement entry for it here (this is a real, deliberate absence, not an oversight). This is the first route with a populated prerequisites block, referencing uk_skilled_worker. citizenship_after_months (12) is time held as ILR before naturalisation eligibility, not from route start.
